quote: Can an o-minimal structure define a function that grows faster than any iterate of exponentiation?
posed_by: Lou van den Dries and Chris Miller
note: The problem was raised in the context of Alfred Wilkie's proof that the real exponential field is o-minimal. Van den Dries and Miller posed the fundamental question about the existence of transexponential o-minimal structures in their 1996 paper.
